summary: PRF Technologies filed a Form 6-K disclosing that S.H.N. Financial Investments, rebuffed after demanding an extraordinary general meeting to replace three non-external directors with its own nominees, petitioned the Tel Aviv District Court (Economic Division) on November 2, 2026, seeking to compel the meeting and interim relief barring out-of-ordinary-course actions, including asset sales, securities issuances under its YA II PN standby equity purchase agreement, and new director appointments. No ruling issued; the company has 20 days to respond and disputes the claims. Watch court scheduling, injunctive relief, and board-control risk.
